exposure: estimating one's child as rather healthy
education of more than ten years
cohort: 1428 women from the KUNO-Kids health study in Germany
finding: The study identified both protective factors (e.g., social support) and risk factors (e.g., parental stress, social and emotional strains) for maternal health four weeks after delivery.
mod_finding: Having a C-section was negatively associated with maternal self-rated health, physical health status, and mental health status.
